{{Top|leg}}
A '''snackquarium''' kept live creatures fresh; meant to be eaten later. [[Nala tree frog]]s are one of the creatures the snackquarium could hold. [[Hutt/Legends|Hutts]] were known owners of these devices. Known owners include [[Jiliac Desilijic Tiron|Jiliac]], who's was in combination with a water pipe, [[Durga Besadii Tai|Durga]], and [[Aruk Besadii Aora|Aruk]].
